top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, its insulinotropic action in humans) whose therapeutic consequences for type 2 diabetes and obesity are unequivocal. The citation is delimited to the physiology and active form, and all six members support the slate entry. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is a defensible allocation within the three-laureate limit, although I originally weighed Knudsen for the analogue engineering. No award is clearly inferior to a ready, well-evidenced prize.
